headline: Holley Acquires SXTH Element to Expand Toyota Performance Parts Business
summary: Automotive performance equipment maker Holley announced the acquisition of SXTH Element to expand its aftermarket product portfolio for Toyota vehicles.
why: Holley is a major player in automotive aftermarket parts, expanding into targeted import performance niches via acquisitions.

impacts.name: Holley Inc.
impacts.why: Acquiring niche aftermarket suppliers expands product lines, with integration success determining long-term earnings impact.
